verdict.rationale: Buyers comparing web-scraping tools can reasonably ask about documented API-key rate limits, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no requests-per-second or requests-per-minute limit tied to an API key. The docs instead stress 'No forced API keys' for the open-source library and describe a self-hosted Docker/FastAPI server with no published throttling thresholds.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
